import sys
import math

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    index = 0
    while index < len(input):
        n = int(input[index])
        m = int(input[index + 1])
        MOD = int(input[index + 2])
        index += 3

        def add_mod(x, y):
            x += y
            if x >= MOD:
                x -= MOD
            return x

        C = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
        for i in range(m + 1):
            C[i][0] = 1
            for j in range(1, i + 1):
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]
                if C[i][j] >= MOD:
                    C[i][j] -= MOD

        sum_n = [0] * (m + 1)
        total_sum = [0] * (m + 1)
        ways = [0] * (m + 1)
        sum_arr = [0] * (m + 1)

        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            sum_n[i] = sum_n[i - 1] + i

        ways[0] = 1
        sum_arr[0] = 0

        for size in range(1, m + 1):
            ways[size] = 0
            sum_arr[size] = 0
            for split in range(size):
                left = split
                right = size - 1 - split
                prod = (ways[left] * ways[right]) % MOD

                ways[size] = add_mod(ways[size], (size + 1) * C[size - 1][split] % MOD * prod % MOD)

                sum_part = 0
                sum_part = add_mod(sum_part, sum_arr[left] * ways[right] % MOD)
                sum_part = add_mod(sum_part, sum_arr[right] * ways[left] % MOD)

                sum_arr[size] = add_mod(sum_arr[size], (size + 1) * C[size - 1][split] % MOD * sum_part % MOD)

                total_sum_part = 0
                total_sum_part = add_mod(total_sum_part, sum_n[left] * ways[right] % MOD)
                total_sum_part = add_mod(total_sum_part, sum_n[right] * ways[left] % MOD)

                sum_arr[size] = add_mod(sum_arr[size], (size + 1) * C[size - 1][split] % MOD * total_sum_part % MOD)

        ways2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
        sum2 = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
        ways2[0][0] = 1
        sum2[0][0] = 0

        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            for j in range(0, min(i, m) + 1):
                ways2[i][j] = ways2[i - 1][j]
                sum2[i][j] = sum2[i - 1][j]
                for k in range(1, j + 1):
                    ni = max(0, i - k - 1)
                    nj = j - k
                    ways2[i][j] = add_mod(ways2[i][j], ways[k] * ways2[ni][nj] % MOD * C[j][k] % MOD)
                    sum2[i][j] = add_mod(sum2[i][j], (sum_arr[k] * ways2[ni][nj] + ways[k] * sum2[ni][nj]) % MOD * C[j][k] % MOD)

        print(sum2[n][m])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
